results.description: Set a network tier when creating new clusters: you can configure the network tier when you create a new cluster regardless of the tier setting on your Google Cloud project. New node pools and new LoadBalancer Services inherit the updated tier configuration, while existing node pools and Services continue to use the original network tier configuration.
